scope: One independent real-client session (r814), read-only client memory samples plus static disassembly of the exact runtime image; no gameplay or protocol patch added
hypothesis: If usercmd.weapon=0 originates upstream of packet encoding, the native command source should remain zero while the snapshot playerState and render-selected weapon can be 78.
static_chain: 0x572809 reads local cg+0xc7228; 0x57280f reads local cg+0xc7fb0; 0x572825/0x57282b copy these to cl+0x3c60/+0x3c64. Independent alternate path 0x5596e7..0x5596f3 calls 0x5143a0 with the same two cg values, and 0x5143aa/b0 writes the same cl fields.
0x5b2b00 increments cl+0x68d0, calls 0x5b2920, then copies 44 bytes into cl+0x3cd0+(sequence&255)*0x2c.
0x5b2200 reads the low word of cl+0x3c64 at 0x5b2237 and writes command+0x18 at 0x5b2241; this is the first 11-bit weapon field read by packet encoder 0x66f410 at 0x66f7db.
0x5b2c10 indexes the same 44-byte command ring and calls 0x66f410 at 0x5b2f1a to encode the outgoing packet.
0x46155b/0x461567 copy cg+0x3e4 to cg+0xc7fb0 on one path. 0x59040d..0x590435 choose cg+0x3f8 when cg+0x400 bit 1 is clear for the model lookup. These are different source fields.
static_limitations: The exact dynamic path that last wrote cg+0xc7fb0 was not traced; indirect calls, copies and other writers exist. Static data flow does not prove which producer ran in r814 or why cg+0x3e4 was zero. REA Ghidra/IDA/Hopper providers were unavailable on this host, so existing PE/Capstone tools supplied the instruction evidence.
interpretation: This session directly separates rendered/snapshot weapon 78 from the zero-valued native command source. The zero exists before 0x66f410 encodes the outgoing usercmd. The causal reason for cg+0x3e4/cg+0xc7fb0 being zero, and the full snapshot-tail inventory consumption path, remain unverified. Prior r811 independent raw packet decoding found 108 packets with usercmd.weapon=0, including 17 attack packets; r814 did not repeat that raw offline decode.
